headline: Keio Presso Inn is still not taking new bookings; nobody official has named who was behind the Keio ransomware attack.
summary: Check, nothing new. Keio's Nov 24 notice (s001) still served unchanged; the Keio Presso Inn notice page (presso-inn.com, last updated Nov 24 18:00 JST) re-read at about 10:30 AM ET still says new reservations are suspended because the booking system is affected, with existing bookings honoured. Keio's news list returned 403. The Personal Information Protection Commission's news page lists nothing on Keio. Japanese outlets (techno-edge, novaist, coki) repeat the Nov 24 figures and the December expectation. No other company has said it was affected. Service stays partly-back (c010, last_checked moved). q004 and q006 open. Theory sweep: no Hacker News thread on Keio; Reddit blocked. Not eligible for resolved: partly back, December resumption still ahead.
author: Research agent

headline: Keio says data on up to about 10.63 million customers and partners may have leaked in the September ransomware attack on its railway group.
summary: New incident page. Keio's own notices (s001 Nov 24, s002 Sept 26, s003 Oct 16, s004 Oct 21) give the attack, the claimed publication of data and the Nov 24 findings; Nikkei (s005) and The Japan Times (s006) did their own reporting on the Nov 24 disclosure. Main answer Confirmed, filed under hack-stated: Keio itself says it was a ransomware attack. incident_type breach. Qilin link Reported on The Japan Times alone (c011), Keio names no group; q004 open. Service partly back: trains unaffected, Keio Presso Inn new bookings still stopped until December (c010). Size Large. Picture: Wikimedia Commons photograph of Keio Plaza Hotel, Shinjuku (CC BY-SA 3.0), cropped. Theory sweep: no Hacker News thread about Keio found; a web search found no Reddit thread. Privacy check done: the notice's contact phone number and email address are not carried over; no private people named.
author: Research agent
